# Bonsai

Bonsai is a fully managed Elasticsearch and OpenSearch hosting service, providing scalable search infrastructure with automatic backups, security, and monitoring.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bonsai/.

## Actions

- **Get Bonsai Cluster Details** (read-only): Retrieve details for a single bonsai cluster by slug.
- **List Bonsai Spaces** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all available spaces.
- **List Spaces**: Retrieve a list of all available spaces.
- **Retrieve Space Details** (read-only): Retrieve details for a single space by its path.
